niche: annotation cost modelling for a data-labeling vendor's batch acceptance: per-object QA misses aggregated into review passes, piece pay against a weekly hourly floor, video frame time on track turnover
answer: Accept Shelfgrid Retail's shelf stills, Ardley Autonomy's highway video and Kestrin Warehousing's warehouse labels at the offered prices; decline Corvane Mobility's crowded street stills and Brindle Pallet Systems' pallet polygons unless their clients come up to at least USD 7.01 and USD 1.95 per image.
analyst_test: The careful but hurried pass models the first-pass return on the counts and settles the floor right, but carries 2026's re-return share along the chain and a per-object-on-screen video rate to requests denser or calmer than any 2026 project, so it accepts the crowded street request and declines the highway video.
domain_test: The call turns on statistical modelling judgments (an any-issue probability aggregated over each image's objects and compounded through a correction chain whose second-stage intensity is fitted as a structural multiplier and extrapolated past the record's support, and the regressor for frame time chosen where the candidate drivers part), each validated on 2026's closed projects; swap the nouns and the aggregation, the chain and the driver choice no longer exist.
layer1: duplicate and auto-closed timesheet punches with supervisor edits
two delivery centres on different local times

stakeholder_role: the vendor's finance lead (not named in the prompt)

spine.entity: one annotation or correction pass on one image or one 25-frame video task

world.geography: Kenya and the Philippines (delivery centres in Kisumu and Iloilo, head office in Nairobi)
world.org_type: data-labeling vendor with a managed annotation workforce

driver: The decisive quantity is a cost defined on a joint condition across an item's parts and compounded through a rework chain that re-applies it to every part, and, for sequential items, driven by what enters and leaves rather than by what is present; a second-stage rate held at the record's average and a stock rate fitted where turnover ran high misprice new items that leave the record's support, in opposite directions.
driver_concrete: Each request's cost per image is built from per-object issue intensities aggregated by the any-issue QA rule into a correction chain whose re-review intensity rises with the image's own, and for the dashcam video from tracks entering and leaving rather than objects on screen; a logistic return model with 2026's re-return share and a per-object-on-screen video rate accept the crowded street request and decline the video.
stump: A competent solver fits per-object time with each annotator's pace, models the first-pass return on the image's object counts and settles the floor per annotator-week, but carries 2026's re-return share of corrected tasks along the correction chain and prices video on frames and objects on screen, so it accepts the crowded street request (A) and declines the highway video (C), where the golden declines A and accepts C.
results: R1 the April to October 2026 delivery cost rebuilt from payroll and the punch clock; R2 QA reviews per delivered image for each request (the any-issue return and its correction chain); R3 annotator paid minutes per image, per frame for the video (track turnover); R4 the floor top-up per image; R5 the costing checked on 2026's closed projects; R6 each request's expected cost per image; R7 the accept set; R8 each cost's 80 per cent range; R9 the lowest acceptable price for each declined request.
one_fact_test: 'QA sends an image back when any one object is missed, so crowded images come back far more often' rescues R2 and the crowded and shelf parts of R6, about 2 of 7.

differentiation.task2: task2 v6 carries a tail share to a compelled population through three partial views of who joins (transport, self-selection, composition); task24 prices work whose cost is a joint failure condition over each item's parts, a hinge over the spread of worker speeds and a turnover-driven frame time, with no population carried through selection and no view of who joins
